name: SoMe
intro: SoMe 是真实社交媒体智能体基准，包含8项任务、32个平台来源、9164284条帖子、6591个用户画像、25686篇报告和17869条标注查询，并通过8个MCP工具评估多步数据获取、分析与推理。
org: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
build_method: 多源公开数据收集, 多媒体转写, 模板与人机交互标注, 10人专业复核
metric: Task Score, Accuracy, Task Completion Rate
eval_feature: 8项社交媒体任务, 8个MCP工具, 噪声长上下文, 多轮工具调用
build_method_en: Multi-source public-data collection, media transcription, template and human-LLM annotation, and review by ten professionals
eval_feature_en: Eight social-media tasks, eight MCP tools, noisy long contexts, and multi-turn tool use
intro_en: SoMe is a realistic social-media agent benchmark with eight tasks, data from 32 platforms, 9,164,284 posts, 6,591 user profiles, 25,686 reports, and 17,869 annotated queries served through eight MCP tools.
metric_en: Task Score, Accuracy, Task Completion Rate

drawio_review_note: Aligned with SoMe arXiv:2512.14720 Section 3, Tables 1-2, Section 4, and Appendices; official LivXue/SoMe repository. SoMe defines eight social-media agent tasks in post-centered, user-centered, and comprehensive classes. It collects public data from 32 social platforms and external sites through commercial data, Weibo crawling, and open datasets, yielding 9,164,284 posts, 6,591 user profiles, and 25,686 fact-check reports. Qwen2.5-VL-72B produces image and video captions and OCR; GPT-4o produces ASR transcripts. Template rules derive queries and ground truths for user-behavior prediction, comment simulation, and recommendation without editing the observed outcomes. Qwen3-32B supports multi-round human-LLM annotation for event detection, streaming summarization, emotion analysis, and social QA, while misinformation data merges LIAR-RAW and RAWFC. Ten professional annotators manually filter and verify all generated ground truths. The final set has 17,869 queries. A platform exposes eight MCP-compatible tools for data access and analysis. Agents receive task queries, call tools, and reason over noisy long-context social data. Three open-ended tasks use LLM semantic comparison; the other five use LLM extraction followed by ground-truth accuracy. All tasks report normalized scores and task completion rate, then average across the eight tasks.
